apps.title: GoreBox 27
apps.summary:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

apps.title: Solitaire Sort: Color Cards!
apps.summary:
Sort colorful cards, merge matching numbers and clear the board in Solitaire Sort: Color Cards! - a relaxing card puzzle that blends the calm rhythm of solitaire with satisfying sort-and-merge gameplay.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a stack to pick it up, then tap where you want to place it.
• Group matching numbers together and merge them into a higher-value card.
• Deal new cards when you need them, but watch your space.
• Plan ahead and complete your goals to win the level.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Easy to learn, hard to master - a fresh twist on classic solitaire.
• Bright, colorful cards that are clear and easy to read.
• Smooth controls and satisfying merge animations.
• A charming royal world with level after level of new puzzles.

SPECIAL CARDS
Keep every level fresh with new card types:
• Joker - a wild card that helps you complete a stack.
• Frozen cards - break the ice before you can use them.
• Mystery cards - reveal what's hidden underneath.
• Tied cards - linked together until you set them free.
• Box and Stone - obstacles that challenge your planning.

POWERFUL BOOSTERS
Stuck on a tough board? Help is always close:
• Burn - choose a column and burn away every card in it to make room.
• Free Move - move a card exactly where you need it.
• Magic Fan - shake up the board for fresh options.

DAILY CHALLENGES & EVENTS
Complete a new challenge every day to fill your calendar and earn amazing rewards, and join special events for even more prizes.
TRAIN YOUR BRAIN, YOUR WAY
Every move counts. Sharpen your logic, focus and planning while you unwind with a calm, colorful card game.
Ready to sort, stack and merge? Download Solitaire Sort: Color Cards! and see how far you can go!

apps.title: Word Blanks: Relaxing Tiles
apps.summary:
Word Blanks 💙 is a relaxing word game for adults where every level brings a gentle workout for your mind! If you love word search puzzles, crosswords, making words from letters and calming flow, this offline game has plenty of satisfying moments in store!

How to Play? 🔤

Get ready for a free mental challenge without ads. Your goal is to find words on a grid of letter tiles. Unlike classic word searches, you can select a letter more than once, and each answer appears on your list. The rules are simple, and every new discovery feels rewarding!

Scan the grid for hidden words. Start with the ones that catch your eye, then look again: a solution might be waiting where you least expect it. A number in each tile’s corner shows how many times to select that letter.

For Everyone Who Loves Word Puzzles! 🤩

Word Blanks is great for fans of crosswords, word searches and anagrams. Spot new letter combinations, put tiles together and watch your list grow. Every find brings you closer to finishing the puzzle!

For Beginners and Experienced Players 🎯

You don't need a huge English vocabulary or years of crossword experience to get started. The first levels help you learn the rules, and the difficulty increases gradually. Even seasoned solvers can put their brain skills to the test.

Word Blanks was made for adults and seniors who appreciate calm, thoughtful offline puzzles. If you enjoy finding hidden answers, spend a few minutes with our free game. We’re sure you’ll love its unhurried rhythm and soothing mind exercises.

Relax at Your Own Pace 🌿

Sometimes we just want to escape the rush, clear our heads and slow down. A calm search within word tiles is a pleasant way to take a short break: over a cup of tea, after work or before bed. A few minutes daily — a nice habit that doesn't wear you out.

We’ve created scenic backgrounds and beautiful chapters to help you unwind after a long day. This relaxing game is perfect for anyone who enjoys cozy activities, spotting patterns and finding joy in little discoveries.

Play Offline ✈️

Word Blanks is a puzzle game you can play with no Wi-Fi, so it’s great for travel or anywhere without internet access. If you're looking for offline games for adults to pass the time on a train, on a plane or while waiting in line, give it a try.

Enjoy free word search with no ads — focus on the puzzle and put your vocabulary to the test. Open the game, select tiles, and fill in the blanks, wherever you are.

A Gentle Mental Stretch 🧠

If you like brain games, each puzzle lets you put your focus, memory and logical thinking to work, recall familiar words and build your vocabulary. Some answers come instantly; others take a little ingenuity and a fresh approach.

Something wrong or have a question? Email us at wordblanks.support@malpagames.com — we're happy to help!

Dive into an addictive world of letters! ⭐ Word Blanks is waiting for everyone who loves to search, spot and solve. How many levels can you complete today?

apps.title: Magic Quiz: Trivia Games
apps.developer: Quiz & Trivia Games by Mno Go Apps
apps.summary:
Magic Quiz – Let Curiosity Work Its Magic!

What if every question could reveal something unexpected?

Welcome to Magic Quiz, a trivia game that turns general knowledge into a collection of delightful discoveries. Choose an answer, uncover a fascinating fact, and let each question lead you to something new.

Magic Quiz is made for curious minds that enjoy learning without lessons or complicated rules. Every round brings a fresh mix of trivia questions inspired by the world around us. Some answers may feel familiar, while others can completely change the way you see an ordinary subject.

WHY PLAY MAGIC QUIZ?

• Discover interesting facts through simple question-and-answer gameplay
• Explore a rich variety of general knowledge topics
• Encounter familiar subjects and unexpected trivia
• Enjoy an elegant liquid-glass visual style
• Move through questions at a comfortable pace
• Use helpful hints when you need a touch of magic
• Return anytime for another quick quiz or a longer trivia session

A LITTLE MAGIC IN EVERY ANSWER

Magic Quiz is not about memorizing textbooks. It is about the spark of finding out why an answer is right, remembering a fact you have not thought about in years, or discovering something completely new.

The rules are simple, but the questions can lead anywhere. One quiz may take you into ancient history, the next into outer space, famous movies, unusual animals, or curious details from everyday life.

Whether you have a few free minutes or feel like exploring question after question, Magic Quiz makes it easy to follow your curiosity. Its clean, shimmering design keeps the focus on the most rewarding part of any quiz game: the moment an answer becomes a discovery.

There is always another curious question waiting to reveal its secret.

Download Magic Quiz and discover what your curiosity will uncover next!

apps.title: Color Away - Tap Block Puzzle
apps.summary:
Color Away is a fun logic game with simple rules: tap a color block to send it through the wall of the same color. Find the right order, clear the board block by block, and enjoy that moment when the final piece escapes!

Unwind with a block game without a timer. Take your time to look over the board and plan your moves. Color blocks need clear paths to escape, but other pieces may stand in their way. Work through each color block jam: spot which pieces can move and choose which block to remove first.

Looking for block puzzle games that are easy to start but keep your mind engaged? Bring a little calm and a challenge to your day with Color Away. Bright colors and smoothly sliding pieces make each board a pleasure to explore, while varied levels challenge your logic, planning, and observation skills. Go from wondering where to start to knowing exactly how to get every block out.

How to Play Color Away:

• Study the board. Each color block moves toward the wall of the same color.
• Find a clear path. Check which color blocks can reach their matching wall without hitting another piece.
• Tap to send a block out. If its entire path is clear, it slides off the board.
• Plan your sequence. Remove blocks to open paths for the others.
• Think before you tap. If another piece blocks the way, your chosen block stays in place and you lose a life.
• Tap away the blocks in the right order. Clear all pieces from the board one by one to complete the level.

Why You'll Love Color Away:

✔ An engaging block puzzle game. Clear each color block jam, spot available moves, and discover which piece opens the next path.
✔ Varying difficulty, from easy boards to tricky levels that keep you thinking one step ahead.
✔ No timer, no rush. Enjoy relaxing block puzzle games at your own pace.
✔ Simple controls with clever logic behind every move—easy to learn, satisfying to master.
✔ A fun way to train your logic, spatial thinking, and focus, perfect for a short break or a cozy evening with a puzzle.

Ready for a colorful block escape challenge? Think ahead, tap out the blocks, and clear the board! Take a break with Color Away and let your mind do the escaping.

Water-sort puzzle gameplay: select bottles, pour water, and sort colors.

Multiple levels with different color arrangements.

Complete levels to unlock in-game CG illustrations and gallery entries.

Undo and restart options to help you adjust your strategy.

Simple tap controls and liquid pouring animations.

Suitable for short breaks or longer play sessions.

Play at your own pace and solve each color-sorting puzzle.

Separate the mixed colors so that every bottle contains only one color. Complete the current level to unlock the next level and its corresponding CG gallery reward.

Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. apps.title: Armor Sandbox
apps.summary:
Armor Sandbox is a 2D impact physics playground. Pick something to shoot, pick something to shoot at, and watch what actually happens.

Nothing here is a canned animation. Every plate, every projectile and every fragment is made of particles that carry real material properties: density, strength, toughness, melting point, heat capacity. Deformation, fracture, spalling, heat, fire and detonation all come from those numbers. Swap the steel for glass and it shatters instead of denting, because glass is brittle, not because somebody drew a shatter effect.

WHAT IS IN IT

• 110+ materials: steels, aluminium alloys, tungsten, uranium, ceramics and glass, concrete and stone, wood, rubber, water, fuel, explosives, nuclear materials and working electrical parts
• 70 projectiles: pistol and rifle rounds, APFSDS long rods, shaped charges, HESH, railgun slugs and three detailed missiles
• 90+ targets: plates, layered armour, deep blocks, ballistic gelatin, bunkers and circuits
• 36 vehicle cutaways: T-34-85, Tiger I, Panther, Sherman, IS-2, T-55, M103, T-72 with and without reactive armour, M1A2 Abrams, Leopard 2A6, Challenger 2, BMP-1, M113 and more, plus cars, trucks, a bus, a tractor, a fighter jet and attack helicopters, each with its real armour, ammunition, fuel and engine inside
• 60+ ready-made experiments, from a ricochet to a chain of nuclear devices

MAKE YOUR OWN

Paint projectiles and targets pixel by pixel, choosing the material of every pixel. Mirror, outline, replace, snap to a grid. Save them to your library and share a design with a friend, or with the community Workshop, as a single small file.

TUNE THE MATERIALS

Change how strong, dense, hot or explosive any material is, and every simulation follows your numbers.

WIRE IT UP

Batteries, capacitors, switches, sensors, delay lines, detonators. Current goes only where you drew a path: an insulated wire along steel leaves the steel dead, bare copper makes the whole plate live. Pressure plates, tripwires, magnetic and proximity sensors, photocells, radio receivers and high-voltage sparks that jump the air.

HEAR IT, RECORD IT

Impacts, explosions, fire and projectiles flying past all sound like the material and the speed. Record your shots as video and share them.

IT RUNS ON A PHONE

The physics core runs in a background thread, so the screen keeps up while the simulation works. Quality follows your device, from 18,000 particles up to a million.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO TRACKING

Nothing you build leaves your device unless you export it yourself.

FREE, AND FULL

Watching is free. Every built-in experiment runs in full, explosives, nuclear devices and circuits included, and so does every vehicle and every material a preset uses. Importing a design someone sent you is free too.

The full version is for making things: painting with energetic, nuclear and electrical materials, editing the properties of every material, a library without the five-per-kind limit, exporting your designs, and the Extreme and Maximum quality levels. One payment, no subscription, no ads either way.

Available in English, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Chinese.

Formerly Armor Simulation.

Explore a playful collection of hands-on skincare, beauty, fashion and styling activities where every level brings a different challenge. Clean up messy details, use treatment tools, try new colors and accessories, then finish each transformation with a three-pose photo shoot.

Clean, Care and Treat

Start with the alligator and work through a dental care routine that includes brace removal, water flossing, bone and lesion removal, teeth cleaning and whitening. Other levels focus on gentler skincare tasks, such as washing away dirt, removing acne or unwanted piercings, applying moisturizer and using a face mask before moving on to the final look.

Hair, Color and Salon Fun

The cat level turns into a complete hair salon session. Remove debris, shampoo and scrub the fur, towel dry it, add colorful dye streaks and use the styling machine to create a new style. Every animal makeover brings a different routine. Trim the watermelon vines, wipe and moisturize the skin, add eye lenses, lipstick, makeup and face painting, then choose clothes for the final reveal.

The parrot can be finished with masks, eyebrow color, body spray, jewelry, eyewear, earrings and an outfit, giving each character its own personality.

Dress Up and Finish

Complete the experience with dress up choices, headbands, lipstick, makeup, hairstyles, clothes and accessories. Each level ends with three posed photos so you can see the finished result from different angles.

Game Features

• ASMR mini games with varied beauty and pet care activities
• Dental, skincare and salon-inspired treatment tools
• Hair styling, color, makeup and dress up choices
• Different animals, outfits and accessory combinations
• Three posed photos after every completed level

apps.title: Christmas Spider Solitaire
apps.summary:
Christmas Spider Solitaire with a twist: hit your goal, flip the cards, sort them into a hidden holiday picture — then unlock it as your own table.

Cozy, festive, and 100% offline. No Wi-Fi needed, no pressure.

Wrap yourself in the magic of the season — twinkling lights, gentle snowfall, and Santa himself dealing the deck. Every hand you win leaves you with something to keep.

SANTA QUEST — OUR TWIST ON SPIDER SOLITAIRE
Classic Spider asks you to clear the board. Santa Quest asks for a goal — and rewards you with a picture.

PLAY — Take on a Spider deal with a real objective: flip face-down cards, free a column, collect an Ace-to-King run, or complete a same-suit sequence.
FLIP — Reach the goal and the hidden cards turn face up, one at a time.
SORT — Arrange every revealed card in the right order to rebuild a Christmas scene: a snowy cottage, Santa's sleigh, a quiet tree by the fire.
UNLOCK — Complete the picture and it's yours. Every finished canvas becomes a new table and background to play on.

Two calm puzzles in one loop — cards first, picture second — and your gallery grows all season long.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic Mode — Traditional Spider Solitaire with 1–4 suits, descending runs, and full board clearing.
• Santa Quest Mode — 150 handcrafted levels across 7 festive chapters. Each chapter gradually reveals a complete holiday scene as you advance.

FESTIVE FEATURES
• Christmas Wonderland Themes: play amid falling snow, glowing fireplaces and northern lights
• Holiday Card Design: card backs crafted with snowflakes, candy canes and Santa suits
• Cozy Winter Sounds: soft jingle bells and gentle ambient melodies
• One to Four Suits: start Easy on a single suit, take on all four when you're ready

DESIGNED FOR COMFORT
• Large cards and clear, easy-to-read numbers
• No timers, no pressure — play entirely at your own pace
• 100% offline: no Wi-Fi, no account, no sign-in
• Drag or tap, with left- and right-handed layouts

UNLOCK & CUSTOMIZE
• Every canvas you complete becomes a table you can play on
• Swap between unlocked backgrounds and card backs
• Build a gallery of Christmas scenes, one puzzle at a time

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
If you love peaceful card games like Solitaire, FreeCell or Klondike — but want something to actually work toward — this is your cozy Christmas sanctuary. The spider game you already know, plus a picture to finish and a gallery to fill. Ideal for unwinding after work, during winter travel, or whenever you need a quiet escape.

HOW TO PLAY
Stack cards in descending order to build same-suit runs. Clear the goal to reveal the hidden cards, then sort them into place to complete the picture. Simple to learn, deeply satisfying to finish. Each victory clears the table — a satisfying way to unwind.

GREAT FOR
• Solitaire lovers looking for a tranquil Christmas escape
• Players who want a goal, not just another high score
• Anyone who enjoys jigsaw, sorting and picture puzzles
• Fans of Spider, FreeCell, Klondike and Patience card games
• Players who prefer larger cards and easy-to-read text

Deck the halls and deal the cards. Start your Christmas adventure today.

"More than a game — a moment of holiday peace."

Questions? Contact us at support@miagame.com

Score Royale turns a standard 52-card deck into a strategy board. Lay your cards out across five tracks, complete classic card combinations, and settle each track for points. Every card you place changes what the next one is worth.

Each round deals you a full deck and five open tracks. A track holds up to five cards and settles the moment it is full, so the order you play matters as much as the cards you keep. Take the safe pairing, or set a card aside in the swap area and reach for a stronger combination.

Five tracks, five spaces each — arrange all 52 cards and settle every track
Classic card combinations, from a simple pair up to the strongest five-card run
Stacked multipliers — the tougher the combination, the higher the score
Swap area to set a card aside and rebuild your layout
Time and heart rewards added to your final result
Four rooms with different deck counts, timers and target scores
Daily challenges and match history to follow your progress
A guided tutorial covering every combination and multiplier

apps.title: MapTap.gg
apps.summary:
MapTap is a daily geography game. Every day you get five places tied to real events from that exact date, and the game is to find each one on a 3D globe. Tap where you think it is. The closer you land, the higher you score. Then you read what actually happened there: a shipwreck, an invention that failed twice before it worked, a border that moved overnight, someone nobody has heard of who changed something you use every day.

It takes about 2 minutes to play. Tomorrow there are five more, and five more the day after that. Keep a streak alive, see how your score sits against everyone else who played that day, or just against players near you. When 2 minutes is not enough, there is a lot more globe. Practice maps run from plain drills to journeys you retrace one stop at a time: Magellan's expedition, Darwin's voyage on the Beagle, Nellie Bly's race around the world, Ibn Battuta's travels. Find the Flag is a daily of its own. Gauntlet is a timed run at a set of locations everybody gets on the same day. Frontier is a survival run where one bad guess ends it. Versus puts you head to head with another player over five locations, with a rating that follows you around. Flashcards drill a map until it sticks.

There are hundreds of achievements to discover. You can build maps for other players, and play other players' maps!

MapTap plays in 12 languages. MapTap+ is an optional subscription that adds sharper satellite detail on the globe, the full run of practice maps, private groups to play alongside friends, the last 90 days of games you missed, drill sets you build yourself, and the curated Best of MapTap collection.

The daily game is free, and there are no ads in it anywhere, for anyone, ever.

apps.summary:
How well do you know the crowd?

Every day, one question. Answer it honestly for yourself - then the real game: predict what percent of everyone else said the same. Lock your guess, no takebacks, and watch the reveal - the crowd's true number, live, and your score is how far away you are. 2% away? You can read the room. 45% off? apps.title: Word Connections Master
apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly
🔹Clean, minimal design that keeps the focus on the words

🌟 A WORD GAME THAT ASKS MORE OF YOU
Most word games ask you to spell, or to guess, or to find. Word Connections Master asks you to understand — to see the relationship between words that, on the surface, share nothing at all.

It is a game about curiosity. About the pleasure of a pattern recognised. About the quiet thrill of a connection finally made. How many will you find?

👉 Download the game for free. Your favourite word association is waiting.

📧 We're always improving and genuinely love hearing your feedback. If you have any suggestions or feedback, write to us at support@quriousbit.com

apps.title: Morning Arrows
apps.summary:
⏰ Morning Arrows is made for people who sleep through normal alarms, hit snooze too often, or turn alarms off without fully waking up.
A basic alarm can be too easy to ignore. One tap can end the sound, but it does not always get you out of bed. Morning Arrows helps change that by adding an optional arrow-based task before the alarm stops.

🕒 Set alarms for work, school, appointments, medication, or daily routines. Choose the time, select repeat days, pick your ringtone, and turn vibration on or off. Then choose how each alarm should work: stop it normally, or require an arrow task before it can be turned off.

➡️ The arrow task adds a quick moment of attention when you need it most. It is simple to understand, easy to follow, and more effective than a standard tap for many people who struggle with half-awake alarm habits.
Morning Arrows is built to be easy to use every day while giving you more control over how strong or active your wake-up routine should feel.

What you can do with Morning Arrows
- Set multiple alarms for different parts of your day
- Use one-time alarms or repeat by weekday
- Choose ringtone and vibration settings
- Stop alarms normally or with an arrow task
- Use different arrow task levels depending on your routine
- Manage everything in a clear, simple layout

Why people use it
- Standard alarms are too easy to dismiss
- Snoozing turns into oversleeping
- A small task helps them wake up more fully
- They want a stronger alarm without a confusing setup
✅ If you need something more effective than a basic alarm clock, Morning Arrows gives you a more active way to wake up and stay on schedule.

apps.title: Domino Blast: Block Puzzle
apps.summary:
Drop blocks. Clear a line. Watch the dominoes fall!

Domino Blast is a colourful block puzzle with a twist. Drag block pieces onto an 8x8 board to fill rows and columns. The dominoes standing on the board count as filled cells too.

Complete a line with a domino in it and the domino tips over. It rushes across the board along its arrow, smashes every block in its path and knocks over the next domino. Chains turn corners, and the fallen dominoes can complete even more lines. One smart move can set off a huge chain reaction.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a piece from the tray onto the board
• Fill a full row or column to clear it
• Topple the dominoes and let the chain do the rest
• Free every domino, or smash the target number of blocks, to clear the level
• No piece fits? You're out of room. Try again, or call in a Domino Drop

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One simple move, easy to learn in seconds
• Big chain reactions with bursts, shakes and rising combo sounds
• Bright, glossy candy colours that are easy to read
• Short levels that flow straight into the next one
• Rainbow dominoes that tip in every direction
• A reward chest every few levels
• Endless levels: ice blocks, bombs and stone walls join the board as you go
• Boss levels with giant chains, and a fresh world look every 40 levels
• Plays offline, no Wi-Fi needed (ads and ad rewards need a connection)

Domino Blast is free to play. It contains ads, including optional reward ads.

Line up the pieces, tip the first domino and blast the board clean!

apps.title: On Raft
apps.summary:
Riley Ashford and her brother Jake are treasure hunters who are looking for an adventure deep within the Bermuda Triangle. Along with their pilot, Marcus Reed, they venture into the unknown — but a powerful magnetic storm suddenly strikes their helicopter.

Jake disappears during the crash. Riley and Marcus are separated, and Riley wakes up alone on a strange island with no way back.

Now she must survive.

Explore mysterious islands, break objects, gather valuable resources, and use everything you find to stay alive. Upgrade Riley’s tools to destroy tougher obstacles and unlock new resources, then craft and improve powerful weapons to face the dangerous enemies lurking across the islands.

But survival is only the beginning.

Build and upgrade your raft to travel between islands and search for a way out of the Triangle. The journey won’t be easy — hostile rafts patrol the waters, and enemy crews will attack when you try to reach new islands. Defeat them in combat and keep moving forward to discover what lies beyond the next horizon.

As Riley’s adventure starts, she encounters traces of an ancient tribe, a mysterious Long Fire, and a secret that has kept these islands isolated from the outside world for generations.

Gather resources. Upgrade your tools. Craft powerful weapons. Defeat enemies. Explore this adventure game!

Can Riley survive the Bermuda Triangle and find a way home? 🌊🔥🏝️

Match Fighters: The Ultimate Merge & Battle Tower Defense Adventure!

Welcome to Match Fighters — where strategic merge puzzles meet epic tower defense battles! Merge warriors, upgrade your fighters, and defend your castle against waves of relentless enemies. Every match counts in this addictive blend of puzzle strategy and auto-battle action!

Drag and merge fighter pieces on the grid to create powerful warriors. Use your limited moves wisely to build the strongest army. When the battle begins, watch your fighters charge into action and crush incoming enemy waves before they reach your tower!

Strategic Merge Gameplay: Match 3, 4, or 5 fighter pieces to create increasingly powerful warriors. L-shaped and T-shaped combos unlock elite fighters with devastating abilities!

Epic Auto-Battle Action: Once your army is ready, watch the action unfold! Your merged fighters automatically engage enemies in thrilling wave-based combat. Deploy boosters at critical moments to turn the tide!

• Footman – Balanced melee fighter
• Warrior – Fast DPS with deadly sword strikes
• Tanky – Heavy frontline that pushes enemies back
• Archer – Precise ranged damage dealer
• Wizard – Devastating area-of-effect magic attacks
• Bomber – Explosive kamikaze that wipes out groups

Hatch and upgrade powerful dragon companions that fight alongside your army:
• Fire Dragon – Rains fireballs on enemy groups
• Poison Dragon – Creates toxic pools that damage enemies
• Ice Dragon – Freezes and slows approaching threats

🏰 TOWER DEFENSE
Upgrade your castle tower from a basic stronghold to an attack fortress! Higher tower levels unlock auto-attack, rapid fire, area damage, and knockback abilities.

Turret: Deploy a high-damage turret for 15 seconds of destruction.
Shield: Protect all your fighters with an invincibility barrier.

Choose powerful upgrade cards between waves! Arrow Rain, Ninja Assassin, Snowball Slam, Bomb Strike, and more — customize your strategy every battle!

Brain-Teasing Merge Puzzles: Every move matters! Plan your merges carefully to maximize fighter power with limited moves.

Roguelike Progression: Wave cards, random upgrades, and evolving challenges make every run unique.

Idle-Friendly Battles: Set up your fighters and watch the auto-battle unfold — perfect for quick sessions!

Boss Battles: Face terrifying bosses with unique mechanics — Ice Boss, Fire Boss, Forest Boss, and more!

Competitive Rankings: Climb Global and Local leaderboards to prove you are the ultimate Match Fighter!

Offline Play: No internet required! Battle anytime, anywhere.

Drag and drop pieces to merge matching fighters.
Use your limited moves to create the strongest army.
Hit FIGHT and watch your warriors battle enemy waves.
Choose wave cards to power up between rounds.
Upgrade fighters, tower, pets, and cards to grow stronger.

Download Match Fighters now and prove your strategic mastery in the most addictive merge & battle game on the store!
